messages.subject: Project Larkspur - exchange tomorrow + completion statement
messages.plaintextBody:
Isla, Rebecca,

We're set to exchange tomorrow (24 April). The 10% deposit of £1,425,000 needs to be with Castle & Vane (as stakeholder) by 11am. Attached is the draft completion statement - the balance due from you on completion (8 May) is £12,600,864.04 after the deposit, rent and service charge apportionments and the rent deposit transfers.

Please confirm the deposit funds are ready.

Elena

Elena Marchetti
Associate - Real Estate
Whitfield Carter LLP

Whitfield Carter LLP, 22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ
Confidential and may be legally privileged.
